This indicates a hierarchical interaction where Ent-Gloeosteretriol may influence the signaling cascade through Sinocalycanchinensin G, potentially modulating pim-3 activity. The presence of multiple paths with varying scores suggests that the relationship is robust but may be influenced by the specific context of the targets and their interactions. The integration of these pathways highlights the role of Sinocalycanchinensin G as a central mediator in the signaling network, with Ent-Gloeosteretriol acting as a potential upstream activator.
